_note: Round 119 (Robert, 2026-10-13): 'During blacksmithing allow for player to design the look of the gear and it can potentially increase or decrease the items bonuses or attributes in unique ways. Same for all crafting.' Each craft has a design section; a choice has a name, a skill needed, an item it costs, what it does to the numbers (ward_mult, hp_mult, weight_mult, value_mult and 'effect' like a technique's), and what it looks like (color, glow). Pluses always come with minuses. scripts/systems/Design.gd reads this. Dev writes the words.

plain.name: Plain
plain.desc: No ornament. Nothing gained, nothing lost.

studded.name: Studded
studded.desc: Rows of studs. More ward, heavier.

filigree.name: Filigree
filigree.desc: Fine wirework. A little less ward, a little more qi, worth more.

flared.name: Flared plates
flared.desc: Wide, stout plates. Strong ward, heavy, less to wear it on.

runic.name: Runic lines
runic.desc: Glowing cut lines. Harder strikes, a touch more fragile.

silver.name: Silver trim
silver.desc: Costs a silver ore. A little qi and a little worth.

gold.name: Gold trim
gold.desc: Costs a gold nugget. Better finds, heavier purse to lose.

jade.name: Jade inlay
jade.desc: Costs a rough jade. Calmer qi, softer plates (a little less ward).

midnight.name: Midnight
midnight.desc: Blued dark. Harder to spot (a touch more dodge), dull to sell.

crimson.name: Crimson
crimson.desc: Blood red. Fiercer, a little more taken.

bone.name: Bone white
bone.desc: Pale. Plain to look at, kind to the purse.

slender.name: Slender vial
slender.desc: Concentrated: stronger, a little less to sell.

wide.name: Wide flask
wide.desc: Makes two, each a little weaker.

twin.name: Twin-chambered
twin.desc: Two doses, almost full strength. Costs a silver ore.

spirit.name: Spirit-herb tincture
spirit.desc: Costs a spirit herb. More qi, a touch less healing. Herbalism 1.

ember.name: Ember-root tincture
ember.desc: Costs an ember root. Stronger healing, a bit less qi. Herbalism 2.

moon.name: Moonpetal tincture
moon.desc: Costs a moonpetal. A fine, balanced lift. Herbalism 4.

jade.name: Jade stopper
jade.desc: Costs a rough jade. A little stronger, worth more.

gold.name: Gold-sealed
gold.desc: Costs a gold nugget. Prized, hardly stronger.

poultice.name: Poultice
poultice.desc: Heals a little more, a little less to sell.

tonic.name: Gentle tonic
tonic.desc: Makes two, each a little weaker.

draught.name: Strong draught
draught.desc: Much stronger, but the body pays: less qi.

spirit.name: Spirit-herb tincture
spirit.desc: Costs a spirit herb. More qi, a touch less healing. Herbalism 1.

ember.name: Ember-root tincture
ember.desc: Costs an ember root. Stronger healing, a bit less qi. Herbalism 2.

moon.name: Moonpetal tincture
moon.desc: Costs a moonpetal. A fine, balanced lift. Herbalism 4.

cabochon.name: Cabochon
cabochon.desc: Smooth and calming. Worth a little less.

brilliant.name: Brilliant cut
brilliant.desc: Sharpens the eye for the killing blow, and the thief's eye too.

claw.name: Claw setting
claw.desc: Bites into the wearer's strikes; a touch more taken.

bezel.name: Bezel setting
bezel.desc: Snug and safe: a little dodge, a little less strike.

blackened.name: Blackened
blackened.desc: Dull and hard to see. A little less taken, worth less.
